families.abstract_full: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a high-strength line pipe steel material that has excellent fracture toughness in hydrogen in a high-pressure hydrogen gas environment, and that is suitable for use for a steel structure used in a high-pressure hydrogen gas environment, such as a line pipe for 100% hydrogen gas or for natural gas (natural gas is gas containing a hydrocarbon such as methane and ethane as the main component) containing hydrogen at a hydrogen partial pressure of 1 MPa or more; a method for manufacturing the steel material; a steel tube for high-strength line pipes; and a method for manufacturing the steel tube. families.title: Rubber fatigue fracture phase field simulation method based on parameter joint inversion and heat transfer analogy
families.abstract_full: The invention discloses a rubber fatigue fracture phase field simulation method based on parameter joint inversion and heat transfer analogy, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining rubber mechanics and fatigue related data through a test, fitting a hyperelastic constitutive model to obtain material parameters, building a tearing and fatigue fracture finite element model, and carrying out the simulation; a joint parameter inversion framework is built, and the optimal critical energy release rate is obtained through inversion; compiling a subprogram based on the fatigue fracture phase field model, constructing a numerical solution scheme by adopting a steady-state heat transfer equation analogy method, and simulating a rubber fatigue cracking process; and finally, inverting an optimal material fatigue parameter by relying on a joint parameter inversion framework, updating a subprogram parameter and recalculating to obtain an optimal simulation result. The problem that fatigue parameters of the rubber material are difficult to obtain is solved, synchronous coupling simulation of phase field evolution and material deformation is achieved, calculation cost and engineering application technical difficulty are reduced, and the method is suitable for failure analysis of the rubber material and structure.

The reinforcing ring and the anti-fracture supporting sleeve enhance the connecting strength and supporting, and the fracture risk is reduced; and through the cooperation of the connecting piece and the connecting block and the flexibility of the corrugated hose, fatigue damage is reduced, and the anti-fatigue performance is improved. The sealing washer guarantees sealing, prevents leakage and ensures normal operation of a hydraulic system.

families.abstract_full: A calibration method of a battery electronic control unit (ECU) according to the present disclosure uses an inspection device.
